exact_holds.description: §15.7 Services-Services Matrix explicitly future, no table rows exist.
Alternative nondefault interconnects have conformance TBD.
Conditional FACE Transport API Rule does not apply to every module, original FACE3.1 unread.
Observation15.2-2 cites Rule14.2-1 although it is an RTE file rule.
QoS implementation postponed, source policy taxonomy not live behavior.
Sensor-to-sensor QoS explicitly outside scope.
QoS Priority upper X undefined.
QoS Deadline and Liveliness intervals not message expiry or UTC.
Durability source prose typo PERSITENT vs table PERSISTENT.
SHARED_EXCLUSIVE ownership original description incomplete.
Three protocol bindings are alternatives only under stated conditions.
OMG DDS/RTPS Protobuf AMQP ZMTP native normative files unexamined.
FACE3.1 TSS original standard text not independently audited.
Rule15.4-1 infrastructure vs Rule15.4-2 module binding responsibility distinct.
Interaction roles depend on type; not global model classes.
Wideband signal/context/control/discrete differ from SOSA message transport.
Network virtual discrete restricted by performance/safety, physical discrete may remain.
VITA49.2 digital signal context original source unread.
Publish-subscribe implementation not fully determined by C239.
Request-response implementation not fully specified; REST/SOAP/SNMP examples not mandatory CSAPI.
Event acknowledgement possible not universally required.
Conditional TCP TLS1.2+ and UDP DTLS1.2+ enable-disable do not mandate universal always-on encryption.
TLS DTLS native cryptographic standards and actual deployment not examined.
Permission for alternate software/firmware load does not mandate live TLS setting.
Confidentiality integrity authenticity descriptions do not yield CSAPI certificate/authorization schema.
Endpoint-role diagram symbols not fully visually verified.
No empirical source-case protocol QoS TLS or message delivery test.
Eight original native C239 files, later S251, restricted Appendix C held.
External FACE MORA VICTORY OMG and other protocols still unread.
Future Services Matrix and unresolved source omissions prevent donor closure.
No adopted DIM classes Profile SHALLs or independent system conformance.
